user-guide/overview.title: Overview
user-guide/overview.description: LabManager is a comprehensive laboratory management system designed to streamline the operations of medical laboratories. It provides dedicated interfaces and features for different roles within the organization, ensuring each team member has access to exactly the tools they need.

user-guide/roles/admin.title: System Admin Guide
user-guide/roles/admin.description: As an Administrator, you have full access to configure and manage the LabManager system. This includes managing users, laboratories, prices, and system-wide settings.

user-guide/roles/chemist.title: Chemist Guide
user-guide/roles/chemist.description: As a Chemist, your primary role in the LabManager system is to perform laboratory analysis and enter the scientific data that forms the foundation of every medical report. You handle the hands-on diagnostic work — running tests, recording results, and managing cultures and antibiotic sensitivities.

user-guide/roles/doctor.title: Doctor Guide
user-guide/roles/doctor.description: As a Doctor, your primary role in the LabManager system is to review, approve, and oversee medical reports. You focus on clinical interpretation and patient diagnosis, ensuring that every report released by the laboratory meets medical standards.

user-guide/roles/employee.title: Employee Guide
user-guide/roles/employee.description: As an Employee, you have basic access to the LabManager system. The Employee role is a general-purpose role that provides access to core system features without the specialized permissions granted to Administrators, Chemists, Doctors, or Receptionists.

user-guide/roles/patient.title: Patient Guide
user-guide/roles/patient.description: As a Patient, you use LabManager to stay updated on your medical reports, view past invoices, and securely interact with the laboratory.

user-guide/roles/receptionist.title: Receptionist Guide
user-guide/roles/receptionist.description: As a Receptionist, you manage the front-desk operations of the medical laboratory, interacting with patients, scheduling tests, and handling billing.
